strategies.name: break_and_retest_continuation
strategies.entry_summary: Identify an obvious key level such as pre-market high/low, previous day high/low, or 30-minute opening range high/low. Enter only after price breaks the level with strong momentum and volume, then retests it and shows confirmation that the level is holding in the breakout direction: bullish price/re
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop on the opposite side of the breakout level, often just beyond the confirmation candle or above/below the retest area. Target the next obvious liquidity area such as a previous high/low, supply zone, or demand zone; partials/break-even management may be used in examples.

variants.variant_label: Long break above resistance, then retest holds as support
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Wait for bullish confirmation on the retest, such as long lower wicks, bullish hammers, dragonfly dojis, or reclaiming/"
variants.target_note: Next obvious liquidity above, such as previous high or pre-market high
variants.transcript_quote: Price breaks above a key level or breaks below a key level, it comes back, it retests that level, and it holds it, and it continues in the original

variants.variant_label: Short break below support, then retest holds as resistance
variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Wait for bearish confirmation on the retest, such as long upper wicks, bearish hammers, gravestone dojis, or rejection
variants.target_note: Next obvious liquidity below, such as previous low or demand area
variants.transcript_quote: If it can become resistance, we're looking to go short, our stop loss is going to be if price comes back up above this break area.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: Use Bookmap liquidity / order flow to visually confirm buyers or sellers at the retest area
variants.transcript_quote: if you like to use order flow, you could use Bookmap liquidity. So, visually seen on the heat map that buyers or sellers are present at that area.

variants.variant_label: Timeframe examples on 5-minute / 2-minute and session-specific levels
variants.timeframe_note: Examples shown on 5-minute candles, possible 2-minute refinement, and levels from pre-market, Asia session, and 30-minOR
variants.target_note: Sometimes trim partials and move the rest to break even in examples
variants.transcript_quote: Maybe it looked better on the 2-minute time frame. But if you ended up going short, again, stop is right above this 30-minute orb low.

result.enumeration_note: One distinct strategy is taught: break-and-retest continuation. Long and short uses are opposite-direction variants of the same break-retest skeleton with shared entry/exit mechanics, and the other differences shown are confirmation/timeframe/management variations rather than separate strategies.
